description: This file contains data access functions for managing flashcards, including listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting flashcard entries in a database, utilizing the Supabase client.

methods.name: map(row)
methods.description: Maps database row data to a flashcard object with proper handling of nulls and nested category info.

methods.name: list({ q, categoryId, partOfSpeech, limit = 50, offset = 0 })
methods.description: Retrieves a list of flashcards, supporting search, filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: getById(id)
methods.description: Fetches a single flashcard by its ID, throwing an error if not found.

methods.name: create({ indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty = 1, categoryId = null })
methods.description: Creates a new flashcard entry in the database with provided data.

methods.name: update(id, { indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty, categoryId })
methods.description: Updates an existing flashcard identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: remove(id)
methods.description: Deletes a flashcard by its ID.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^async function create({ indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty = 1, cate/
ctags.signature: ({ indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty = 1, categoryId = null })

ctags.name: list
ctags.pattern: /^async function list({ q, categoryId, partOfSpeech, limit = 50, offset = 0 }) {$/

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^async function update(id, { indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty, cate/
ctags.signature: (id, { indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty, categoryId })
